goal: Make a new visitor able to save and recover one link
scope: One capture dialog and one result card; preserve existing data and navigation
content: Use an original example link and a title the visitor recognizes. All interface copy is English.

references.transfer: Evaluate the value of fast capture; inspect before making visual claims.

tasks.goal: Save share text without requiring technical knowledge
tasks.method: Forgiving paste with an optional title and inline recovery
steps: Accept a full link surrounded by ordinary share text.
Show a useful result with a remembered title.
checks: Paste a title plus a valid link and find one saved result.
Paste invalid text and see a specific, recoverable error.
Save the same link twice without duplicating it.
